module.summary: Fixed-capacity value table with generation-bearing handles that reject stale references.
module.long_description: Fixed-capacity value table with generation-bearing handles that reject stale references.

purpose.primary: Store values behind index-plus-generation handles so removed and reused slots cannot be accessed through stale identifiers.

c_pain.summary: Raw pointers and array indices can outlive removed resources and silently refer to reused storage.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: Pointers and integer indices are compact and fast.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Lifetime validity is not carried by the identifier and must be reconstructed by convention.

zig_response.summary: Pair every slot index with a generation and validate both on access.
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: do not retain returned pointers across removal or table moves
clean up T-owned resources before or after removal
